summary: KT Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting share repurchases through a trust agreement. On March 10, 2026, KT entered a trust agreement with NH Investment Securities to acquire treasury shares. As detailed, from April 1 to June 8, 2026, KT repurchased a total of 1,871,295 common shares at an average price of approximately 59,153 KRW per share, totaling about 110 billion KRW. As of June 10, 2026, total treasury shares (including direct holdings) stood at 12,689,877 shares, representing 5.04% of issued shares (252,021,685). The largest shareholder holdings remained unchanged. This open-market buyback program is a capital return to shareholders. Watch for ongoing execution pace and any potential cancellation of repurchased shares.
